scope: Single derived numerical scenario; not the original full contest problem
acceptance: Fresh default Guidance pipeline generates the model from the frozen task; no probe model, reference answer, output repair, or source/review bypass.
Original four asset rows and bank rate match the source; capital and risk cap remain explicit scenario conditions.
Allocation and bank balance are nonnegative and sum with actual fees to 10000 yuan within 1e-6 yuan.
Fees are zero at zero purchase, p*u for a positive purchase below u, and p*x above u; all four assets must follow the rule.
Maximum individual loss q*x is at most 200 yuan within 1e-6 yuan; do not substitute a sum or bare risk rate.
Recompute net profit including bank interest and all actual fees; end wealth minus capital must agree within 1e-6 yuan.
Feasible net profit agrees within 1e-6 yuan with independent exact enumeration of all 81 fee regimes; equivalent optimal allocations are allowed.
Production source, model review and numerical checks remain intact; rejected/unknown/failed evidence is not promoted.
Guidance/report contains all four allocations and fees, bank balance, maximum loss, net profit, all-bank comparison, source and scenario limitations.
Reproduce the frozen response and computation in a fresh directory; preserve dependency versions, contract/source hashes, request and usage ledger.
Do not claim full original-problem completion, predictive investment accuracy, generalization, or autonomous-harness capability.
reference_policy: The independent verifier and manual probe artifacts are audit-only and must never be included in model requests.
